# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION", "data")
reference_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "ref_files")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "code", "R")

source(file.path(code_dir, "parallel_functions.R"))
```

# Define Functions

## Get Residuals

```{r func_resid}
run_resid_test <- function(pheno_df, fo) {
  formula <- as.formula(fo)
  lm_mod <- stats::lm(formula, data = pheno_df, na.action = na.exclude)
  resids <- stats::residuals(lm_mod)

  resids
}

calculate_residuals <- function(pheno_df) {
  fo <- paste(
    c(
      "VS4MEM_EAP ~ ",
      "Age",
      "Gender",
      "APOE4",
      "prop_B",
      "prop_NK",
      "prop_CD4",
      "prop_MO",
      "prop_GR"
    ),
    collapse = " + "
  )

  resid_vals <- run_resid_test(pheno_df, fo)

  pheno_df$resid <- resid_vals

  # Smoking_Adjusted sensitivity analysis: also adjust the memory residual
  # for the DNAm-based SSc smoking score (computed in 01d)
  fo <- paste0(fo, " + Smoking_Score")
  resid_vals <- run_resid_test(pheno_df, fo)
  pheno_df$resid_smoke <- resid_vals

  pheno_df
}

add_residuals <- function(pheno_df) {
  pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        c(
          "VS4MEM_EAP",
          "Age",
          "APOE4",
          "prop_B",
          "prop_NK",
          "prop_CD4",
          "prop_CD8",
          "prop_MO",
          "prop_GR",
          "Smoking_Score"
        ),
        as.numeric
      ),
      Gender = as.character(.data$Gender)
    )

  # The smoking-adjusted analysis must use the same participants
  stopifnot(!anyNA(pheno_df$Smoking_Score))

  pheno_df <- calculate_residuals(pheno_df)

  pheno_df
}
```

## Load Data

```{r func_load}
filter_probes <- function(dnam_data) {
  row_df <- dnam_data %>%
    SummarizedExperiment::rowData() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::filter(!.data$filter_snp)

  dnam_data[row_df %>% dplyr::pull("Name"), ]
}

get_dnam_data <- function(pheno_df) {
  dnam_data <- readRDS(
    file.path(hrs_dir, "batch_corrected", "HRS_White_NHispanic_PCA.RDS")
  )
  dnam_data <- dnam_data[
    , dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter %in% pheno_df$SubjectID_Submitter
  ]
  dnam_data <- filter_probes(dnam_data)

  dnam_data
}

get_study_data <- function() {
  pheno_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "NHW_HCAP_MCI.csv")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data$APOE4),
      !is.na(.data$Gender),
      !is.na(.data$Age),
      !is.na(.data$VS4MEM_EAP),
      !is.na(.data$Z_PTAU181)
    ) %>%
    add_residuals()
  dnam_data <- get_dnam_data(pheno_df)
  pheno_df <- pheno_df[
    match(dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter, pheno_df$SubjectID_Submitter),
  ]
  beta <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam
  row_df <- dnam_data %>%
    SummarizedExperiment::rowData() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  row.names(pheno_df) <- colnames(beta)

  dnam_data <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(dnam = beta),
    colData = pheno_df,
    rowData = row_df
  )

  dnam_data
}
```

## Annotations

```{r func_annot}
get_nasser_data <- function() {
  celltypes <- readxl::read_xlsx(
    file.path(reference_dir, "Nassser study selected biosamples.xlsx"),
    col_names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(1)
  df <- readr::read_tsv(
    file.path(
      reference_dir,
      "AllPredictions.AvgHiC.ABC0.015.minus150.ForABCPaperV3.txt.gz"
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$CellType %in% celltypes) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!.data$isSelfPromoter) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$class != "promoter") %>%
    dplyr::select(
      seqnames = "chr",
      "start",
      "end",
      celltype = "CellType"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  df
}

get_hg19_positions <- function() {
  anno_df <- utils::data(
    "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19",
    package = "IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19"
  ) %>%
    minfi::getAnnotation() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      CpG = "Name",
      seqnames = "chr",
      start = "pos",
      end = "pos"
    )

  anno_df
}

get_nasser_annotation <- function() {
  nasser_df <- get_nasser_data() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      start = .data$start - 250,
      end = .data$end + 250
    )
  anno_df <- get_hg19_positions()

  nasser_gr <- nasser_df %>%
    GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame()
  anno_gr <- anno_df %>%
    GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame()

  hits_df <- findOverlaps(anno_gr, nasser_gr) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  anno_df <- data.frame(
    CpG = anno_df$CpG[hits_df$queryHits],
    CellType = nasser_df$celltype[hits_df$subjectHits]
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$CpG) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(CellType = paste0(.data$CellType, collapse = ";")) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  anno_df
}

get_stored_annotations <- function(dnam_data) {
  row_df <- dnam_data %>%
    SummarizedExperiment::rowData() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      CpG = "Name",
      Chr = "seqnames",
      Position = "pos",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Name",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Group",
      "Relation_to_Island"
    )

  row_df
}

get_great_annotations <- function() {
  great_df <- readRDS(file.path(reference_dir, "GREAT_EPIC_hg38.RDS")) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      CpG = "cpg", "GREAT_annotation"
    )

  great_df
}

get_probe_annotations <- function(dnam_data) {
  nasser_df <- get_nasser_annotation()
  row_df <- get_stored_annotations(dnam_data)
  great_df <- get_great_annotations()

  probe_df <- row_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(great_df, by = "CpG") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(nasser_df, by = "CpG") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      nasser_is_enhancer = ifelse(is.na(.data$CellType), 0, 1)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::replace_na(list(CellType = "")) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "CpG",
      "Chr",
      "Position",
      "GREAT_annotation",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Name",
      "UCSC_RefGene_Group",
      "Relation_to_Island",
      nasser_enhancer_cell_type = "CellType",
      "nasser_is_enhancer"
    )

  probe_df
}
```

## Association Test

```{r func_assoc}
# Estimate, SE, t, P and z of one model term, with column names ending in
# "_<suffix>".
select_term_stats <- function(coef_df, term, suffix) {
  term_df <- coef_df[
    term, c("estimate", "std_error", "t_value", "pvalue", "zvalue")
  ]
  colnames(term_df) <- paste0(
    c("estimate", "std_error", "tvalue", "pvalue", "zvalue"), "_", suffix
  )

  term_df
}

run_lm_step <- function(beta_value, pheno_df, formula) {
  # put beta_value on a percent scale
  beta_value <- 100 * beta_value

  data <- data.frame(dnam = beta_value, pheno_df)
  lm_mod <- stats::lm(formula, data = data)

  coef_tbl <- data.frame(summary(lm_mod)$coefficients)
  df_resid <- stats::df.residual(lm_mod)

  t_vals <- coef_tbl[, "t.value"]
  p_vals <- coef_tbl[, "Pr...t.."]
  z_vals <- stats::qnorm(stats::pt(t_vals, df_resid))

  coef_df <- janitor::clean_names(coef_tbl) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pvalue = p_vals,
      zvalue = z_vals,
      df = df_resid
    )

  cbind(
    coef_df["dnam", "df", drop = FALSE],
    select_term_stats(coef_df, "dnam", "dnam"),
    select_term_stats(coef_df, "Z_PTAU181", "ptau"),
    select_term_stats(coef_df, "Z_PTAU181:dnam", "interact")
  )
}

run_lm_test <- function(beta_vals, pheno_df, fo) {
  parallel_res <- start_parallel(TRUE, 8)
  do_parallel <- parallel_res$parallel
  cluster <- parallel_res$cluster

  formula <- stats::as.formula(fo)

  results <- plyr::adply(
    beta_vals,
    .margins = 1,
    .fun = function(beta_value) {
      run_lm_step(beta_value, pheno_df, formula)
    }, .parallel = do_parallel
  )

  stop_parallel(do_parallel, cluster)

  results <- results %>%
    dplyr::rename(probe = "X1") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fdr_dnam = stats::p.adjust(.data$pvalue_dnam, method = "fdr"),
      fdr_ptau = stats::p.adjust(.data$pvalue_ptau, method = "fdr"),
      fdr_interact = stats::p.adjust(.data$pvalue_interact, method = "fdr")
    )

  results
}
```

## Wrapper Function

```{r func_wrapper}
run_association <- function(dnam_data, outcome = "resid") {
  beta_vals <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam
  beta_vals <- Harman::shiftBetas(beta_vals, shiftBy = 1e-4)
  pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%
    SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%
    as.data.frame()

  fo <- paste0(outcome, " ~ Z_PTAU181 + dnam + Z_PTAU181:dnam")

  run_lm_test(beta_vals, pheno_df, fo)
}

get_association_statistics <- function(dnam_data, annot_df, outcome = "resid") {
  stats_df <- run_association(dnam_data, outcome = outcome)
  stats_df <- annot_df %>%
    dplyr::right_join(stats_df, by = c("CpG" = "probe"))

  stats_df
}

# Primary analysis is saved as EAP_stats.csv. The Smoking_Adjusted sensitivity
# analysis (memory residual also adjusted for Smoking_Score) is saved with a
# "Smoking_Adjusted_" prefix, so no downstream notebook picks it up by accident.
run_model_analysis <- function(dnam_data) {
  pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%
    SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  annot_df <- get_probe_annotations(dnam_data)

  save_dir <- file.path(save_dir, "linear_model")

  stats_df <- get_association_statistics(dnam_data, annot_df, outcome = "resid")
  write.csv(
    stats_df,
    file = file.path(save_dir, "EAP_stats.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  stats_df <- get_association_statistics(
    dnam_data, annot_df, outcome = "resid_smoke"
  )
  write.csv(
    stats_df,
    file = file.path(save_dir, "Smoking_Adjusted_EAP_stats.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    pheno_df,
    file = file.path(save_dir, "Phenotypes.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

# Run Analysis

## Get Data

```{r load}
dnam_data <- get_study_data()
```

## Run for CIND Data

```{r run}
run_model_analysis(dnam_data)
```
